name: multimuse-theme
description: Obsidian theme matched to the MultiMuse and StageHand dashboards

scripts.release:patch: node scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && node -e "console.log('\nVersion bumped. Commit and push to master to publish.')"
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && node -e "console.log('\nVersion bumped. Commit and push to master to publish.')"
scripts.release:major: node scripts/bump-version.mjs major && node -e "console.log('\nVersion bumped. Commit and push to master to publish.')"
